tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shrī badzra kī la ya u pa sā dha kā pra kā sha a mṛ ta pra bhā wān nā ma bi ha ra tisma// ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od can zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shrī badzra ku mā ra kro dhā ya na mā mya haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las drag po'i sku/ /rdo rje gsum gyi zhal ldan pha rol phyin/ /phyag gi yal gas rab brjid dbang sngon mdangs/ /khro bo'i dbang po mchog la gus btud nas/ /de nyid sgrub thabs 'khrul med brgyud pa'i gsung / /zhal gyi bdud rtsi las rnyed bsnyen sgrub tshul/ /gsal bar ston pa'i man ngag 'dir bshad kyis/ /don gnyer shes ldan gus pa'i tshul gyis nyon/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu sa lugs su grags pa 'di la/ rtsa ba rdo rje khros pa'i rgyud kyi lag len zur du phyung ba/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud chung 'di nyid la brten nas slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rdo rje las rim rtsa 'grel nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi tho yig mdzad pa gzhir bzhag nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sgrub thabs che 'bring chung du gsum mdzad pa las/ rgyun du nyams su len pa dang dus dang grangs kyi bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshe sgrub thabs chung ba 'di nyid don tshang la nyams su len bde bas/ de'i tshul dkyus su mi gsal ba cung zad brjod na/ thog mar gang du bsnyen pa bya ba'i sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i sgrub khang bla ma gong ma yid ches pa rnams kyi bzhugs nas yin pa'am/ yang na 'dre srin gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa ma yin par rang gi mdun du bla ma yi dam gyi rten gang rigs dang / khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i sku lugs ma'am/ bris sku rab gnas can gyi mdun du/ 'di'i gtor la stod zur gsum/ smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba la/

ched du bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa dbus su bzhag de'i g.yon du bandha lcang lo can gyi nang du rakta/ gtor ma'i g.yas su thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du sman phud gtsang ma/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa phreng du bshams/ rang nyid shar raṃ lhor kha phyogs pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ nam mkhar bla ma yi dam chos srung rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos nas skyabs 'gro khyad par bzhi gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar gsal btab la/ skyabs 'gro gzhung bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam byas pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /sogs mngon rtogs rgyas pa bzhin byas la/ shūn+ya ta'i rjes su phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badzra añdza li hūm̐/ badzra bandha badzra añdzi li dzaḥ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag myur du brdung la/ phaṭa gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /ces pa nas kī la ya dang khro bo bcu'i sngags brjod/ hūm̐ khro bo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim/ yang rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs byung nas sna bug nas thon/ g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs bskrad de ra bar gyur/ hūm̐ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ /sogs nas/ ā yu dha rakṣa'i bar brjod/ sems kyis rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rgya gram/ dbyug to rnams spros nas 'og tu de dag gi sa gzhi/ logs su ra ba/ steng du gur la sogs par gyur par bsams te/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur rgyab sbyar mthe chung sbrel mthe bos srin mdzub mnan/

gung mdzub gnyis gyen du sgreng ba'i phyag rgya g.yon du bskor zhing bgegs bskrad/ phyag rgya g.yas su bskor bas ra gur du gyur par bsam la/ sngags tshar gnyis brjod/ srung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ zhes pa nas/ me ri'i sngags kyi bar mngon rtogs rgyas pa bzhin ngag tu brjod cing lus kyi phyag rgya/ sems kyi dmigs pa gsal 'debs pa sogs bya ste/ /mtshams bcad cing srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru sogs nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs sho lo ka gcig po tshar gsum/ mdun gyi tshogs kyi zhing de dag thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi snying khar thim/ yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang / byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor kyi gnas su thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur/ a la la hoḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod/ de'i dus kyi dmigs pa ni/ snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam pas mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad yab yum mnyam par sbyar bas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa 'od kyi rnam pa can sbyor mtshams nas byung bas rang dang gnas la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sman raka gtor ma rnams mngon rtogs rgyas pa ltar bsnyen phur byin gyis brlab pa'i bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa stong nyid spros pa dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang /

stong pa nyid de 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab cing de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje sgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thabs shes rab gnyis med rang rig gsal la ma 'gags pa de yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig gyur pa rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta nas skyon thams cad dag par byas/ zhes pa'i bar dang / e/ yaṃ/ baṃ/ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ e/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings sogs nas/ dbus su keṃ rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras/ /zhes pa nas gtso bo yab yum bskyed cing / ye shes pa dgu gzhug gi bar mngon rtogs bsdus pa lta bur bya/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i skabs su/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying khar oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsams nas de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje 'bru gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum du gyur par bsam la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /sogs sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin bya/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'ang bya'o/ /phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ e spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ zhes brjod pas phur gdan e las gru gsum mthing nag 'bar bar bskyed/ sarba sha truṃ sogs brjod dus gru gsum gyi dbus su dgra bgegs thams cad bkug par bsam/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi phur pa la gu gul gyis bdug cing yungs kar gyis brab/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ gcig chad pa mdun du sras mchog zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa'i sku bsam la/ skye med rnam dag sogs nas mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/

badzra kī li kī la ya dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar brjod pas sras mchog smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa la/ stod zhal gsum phyag drug par bsams te/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la sogs nas/ phur pa chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas bzung nas/ dīpta tsakra phur pa'i lha/ /zhes pa nas/ dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / lte ba man chad sogs la phur bu sgril nas sngags rnams brjod dus phur mgo spyi gtsug dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas/ ltag pa/ rna ltag g.yon dang / ka ya sogs brjod dus dpral mgrin snying khar reg pas khro bo khro mo thams cad kyi phrin las bdag la 'dus par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor la dam can srung mas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam zhing / bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang / /sprul pa yang sprul bka' bstod srung ma'i tshogs/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang / zhabs bsil gdan dbul sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin byas rjes/ sgeg phreng sogs kyi phyi mchod dang / yang snying lhan skyes ltar bya/ nang mchod rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /sogs nas/ ka pā la bandha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin bya/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rje cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ 'jigs byed chen po khro bo yab yum bcu/ /sprul pa'i phra thabs yab yum nyi shu dang / /sgo ma bzhi dang sras mchog phur bu'i tshogs/

/rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum sde dang / /dpag bsam shing lha re ba ti rnams la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /shwa na mu kha bdag nyid chen po dang / /bse yi lha mo phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor tshogs/ /dam srung mched lcam bstan ma bcu gnyis la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du khā hi/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i zhal du khā hi/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal du khā hi/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas zhal du khā hi/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ khyad par chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rang gi lce la nang mchod bzhag nas/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag thams cad la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen sogs/ gsang mchod dang / de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa gnyis mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang rung ltar bya/ bsgral mchod ni/ rang gi thugs kha nas khro bo khro mo phra thabs sgo ma sras mchog dam can gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad bsgral bar bsam zhing / dam tshig chen po nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar bsdus pa bzhin byas rjes/ rakta'i mchod pa ni/ rgyas bsdus gang rung skabs dang mthun par bya zhing / gtor ma'i mchod pa dang / bstod pa gnyis bsdus pa bzhin bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i skabs su hūm̐ badzra dzñā na kī li kī la ya zhes brjod dus/ rang gi snying kha'i ye shes sems dpa' las/ de dang 'dra ba yum med gcig mdun du bye nas rang la zhal phyogs par bzhugs dzñā na sa twa e tri ko ṇa sogs brjod dus rang gi snying khar gru gsum mthing nag gi dbus su padma nyi zla'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra yum med pa'i thugs khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐ sngon po yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar kī la ya'i sngags kha dog sngon po skra shad kyis bris pa lta bu g.yas skor du bsam nas/

gru gsum mthing nag sogs rgyas pa bzhin brjod/ rang gi snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las sngags phreng kha dog sngon po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba lcags sgrog sbrel ba lta bu rdo rje'i dbus rang nas byung / ye shes sems dpa' dang rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir thon/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang de las sngags phreng byung / mdun gyi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ rang dang ye shes sems dpa'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs rdo rje'i dbus ra nas song / /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing / sngags phreng phyir 'gro dus de las rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang / bgegs dang bar chod thams cad zhi bar byas/ sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gyur/ sngags phreng nang du 'ong dus sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam thams cad kyi byin rlabs rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur byas nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab/ rang gi sngags brjod pa'i tshe mdun gyi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yi dam nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams dang / sems can yi dam gyi skur gyur pa thams cad kyis rang gi sngags bzla grogs byed par bsam zhing / sngags phreng rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba la sems gtad pa ni man ngag dam pa yin no/ /bzlas 'phro 'jog pa na yum gyi sngags ci rigs pa dang / 'di gtor zlog gi lhan thabs na yod/ ma rakmo sogs gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba cung zad bzlas la lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bcug nas kha rlangs phog par byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid bkrag mdangs dang gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ de nas sgeg phreng sogs kyi phyi mchod dang / rang byung gdod nas sogs shlau ka gcig gi mthar ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta sogs kyis nang mchod phul nas/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mi zad dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /zhe sdang thugs mchog yakṣa he ru ka/ /ye shes khro bo che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes dang / lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /kī la ya'i dngos grub stsol/ /de nas gur zhal sogs chos skyong thams cad la gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ yang na thun dang po rnams la/ dkar bdud dam can rnams la phul ba tsam gyi chog pas/ de dag gi gtor ma lag len bzhin bshams pa nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung sogs phur pa'i gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byas rjes 'bru gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas gtor ma 'bul tshul sogs su bshad pa bzhin bya/ thun tha ma'i mjug tu yi dam kye rdor sogs dang / lhan cig gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma byin rlabs kye rdor bzhin byas pas chog gi gzhan byin rlabs zur du mi dgos/ de rjes ye shes lnga ldan sogs kyis dngos grub blang / yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskangs nas/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa la gshegs gsol spyi dang mthun par bya zhing /

shrī badzra ku mā ra kro dha rakṣa dang / ka wa tses lus bsrung zhing go bgo /dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun sogs kyi dge rtsa bsngo ba dang / skye med chos sku sogs kyi bkra shis rnams rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya'o/ /nub tha ma la srung ma rnams kyi gtor ma phul rjes bstod pa byas la mgyogs gtor phul nas/ ye shes lnga ldan man chad bya zhing / dus rgyun du bsnyen pa byed tshul 'di tsam gyi chog la/ skabs su dus bzang ba rnams dang / bsnyen pa thon rjes tshogs lhag ma bstan skyong rnams kyang long skabs dang mthun pa rgyas bsdus gang 'grub bya/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni stod las byang chub sgrub pa la ni tshad med la/ smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang du byas na kī la ya la yi ge srog can bcu drug yod pas 'bru 'bum gyi 'bum phrag bcu drug de'i kha skong khri tsho bcu drug stong phrag bcu drug rnams bzlas nas/ bsnyen pa'i mthar kha skong gi sbyin sreg ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg spyi dang phal cher mthun zhing grangs ni rdzas til lam/ yungs kar gang rung dang sngags kī la ya kho na la grangs bzung nas skabs su/ sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes spel tshig can ci rigs bya/ bsnyen pa'i dus kyang kī la ya kho na la sngags kyi grangs bzung bas chog gi gzhan yum dang 'khor rnams la bsnyen pa zur du mi dgos par phur pa'i yi ge rnying pa las bshad pas phyag len yang gong du bkod pa 'di kho na la mdzad pa bzhin yid gnyis the tshom mi za ba'i tshul gyi sgrub pa la zhugs na yi dam 'di nyid phrin las kyi lha yin pas sgrub thag nye zhing / khyad par bka' srol brgyud pa 'di nas brgyud pa rnams la bsnyen bsgrub kyi dus bar chad mi 'byung ba myong bas grub cing / de yang bla ma rnams byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan thob pa sha stag yin pas 'di lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin na/

gnas skabs su yi dam gzhan gyi gegs sel bogs 'don du 'gyur la/ mthar thug bslu ba med par rdo rje 'chang sku lnga'i rang bzhin can du nges par 'gyur ro/ /ma nor brgyud pa gnyis las legs 'ongs ba'i/ /shin tu zab pa'i man ngag gnad 'di dag /snyigs dus blo dman rnams kyi yul min yang / /gzhan la phan pa'i sems kyis 'di bris pa'i/ /dge ba dri med gang des skye dgu kun/ /'khrul med dam pa'i rjes su rab zhugs te/ /yang dag lam la brtson pa lhur blang nas/ /dpal ldan kun tu bzang po nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni/ rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub byed tshul yi ge rnying pa rnams su cung zad mi gsal ba gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan te/ mi'i dbang po sgrol ma rab brtan dpal bzang pos bkas bskul ba bzhin/ dpal sa skya paṇṭi ta shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sgrol byed kyi lo nag pa zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus nyi shu lnga la dpal snar thang gi gtsug khang chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod dang ldan pa zla ba grags pas bris pa'o// //i daṃ sarba satwa sya hi to bha wantu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
